+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,23 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests live in `tests/` as `test_*.py` files and run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or a single test:
+
+```sh
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py::test_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+The stdlib runner also works if you'd rather not install anything:
+
+```sh
+python -m unittest discover
+```
